requirement: Resolve currency quotes using a five-second cache, single-flight loading, bounded provider calls, and stale fallback.
constraints: preserve caller-visible request and response types

requirement: Settle a batch with idempotency, retry only failed items, prevent duplicate receipts, and preserve input ordering.
constraints: one ordered item result per input instruction
a successful instruction produces at most one receipt
retry policy applies only to transient item failures

requirement: Route quote requests across primary and backup providers using isolated circuit breakers and half-open recovery.
Consume trade messages exactly once per message identifier while serializing work per account and allowing cross-account concurrency.
constraints: retain source order within an account
do not globally serialize independent accounts

requirement: Flush buffered audit entries safely on a threshold or timer and drain all remaining entries during shutdown.
constraints: only one drain owns a batch
timer and threshold may race safely
shutdown awaits the final durable write
